title: Jeremiah Bible Quiz - Chapter 13
description: Ten questions on Jeremiah 13: the ruined linen belt at the Euphrates, containers filled with wine, fallen crowns, and the leopard's spots.

questions.text: What was the speaker told to buy and put on his waist?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said, "Go, and buy yourself a linen belt, and put it on your waist, and don't put it in water."

questions.text: Where was the speaker told to hide the belt?
questions.explanation: Yahweh told him to go to the Euphrates and hide the belt there in a cleft of the rock, and he went and hid it by the Euphrates.

answers.text: Under the floor of his house
In the sand of the seashore
In a cleft of the rock by the Euphrates

questions.text: What condition was the belt in when the speaker dug it up after many days?
questions.explanation: When he took the belt from the place where he had hidden it, the belt was ruined; it was profitable for nothing.

answers.text: It was ruined and profitable for nothing
It was as good as the day he bought it
It had been stolen out of its place
It was soaked with water but still whole

questions.text: What does Yahweh say He will ruin in the same way as the belt?
questions.explanation: Yahweh says, "In this way I will ruin the pride of Judah, and the great pride of Jerusalem."

answers.text: The walls and the strong gates of Jerusalem
The riches of the kings who sit on David's throne
The pride of Judah and the great pride of Jerusalem
The altars of Baal in the streets of the city

questions.text: Just as the belt clings to a man's waist, what had Yahweh caused Israel and Judah to do?
questions.explanation: As the belt clings to the waist of a man, so Yahweh caused the whole house of Israel and the whole house of Judah to cling to Him, that they might be His people, but they would not hear.

questions.text: With what does Yahweh say He will fill all the inhabitants of this land, even the kings and priests?
questions.explanation: After the word about every container being filled with wine, Yahweh says He will fill all the inhabitants of the land, the kings on David's throne, the priests, the prophets and all Jerusalem, with drunkenness.

questions.text: What are the king and the queen mother told to do?
questions.explanation: They are told, "Humble yourselves. Sit down, for your crowns have come down, even the crown of your glory."

questions.text: From which direction do those come whom the people are told to lift up their eyes and see?
questions.explanation: The text says, "Lift up your eyes, and see those who come from the north," and asks where the beautiful flock is.

questions.text: Which two examples does this chapter use to ask whether those accustomed to evil can do good?
questions.explanation: The text asks, "Can the Ethiopian change his skin, or the leopard his spots? Then may you also do good, who are accustomed to do evil."

answers.text: The eagle changing its wings and the ox its horns
The Ethiopian changing his skin and the leopard his spots
The river flowing backward and the mountain moving
The fig tree bearing olives and the vine bearing figs

questions.text: Why does Yahweh say this lot has been measured to Jerusalem?
questions.explanation: Yahweh says, "This is your lot, the portion measured to you from me, because you have forgotten me, and trusted in falsehood."

answers.text: Because they forgot Him and trusted in falsehood
Because they made treaties with Egypt
